headings: About Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension and Pulmonary Hypertension Associated with Interstitial Lung Disease
Other Diseases Being Investigated by Liquidia
YUTREPIA (treprostinil) Inhalation Powder to Treat PAH and PH-ILD
Treprostinil Injection, a Generic Version of Remodulin
The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
paragraphs: We are a biopharmaceutical company driven by science and compassion to revolutionize care for patients with challenging respiratory and vascular diseases such as pulmonary arterial hypertension ("PAH") and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease ("PH-ILD"). We operate through our wholly owned operating subsidiaries, Liquidia Technologies, Inc. and Liquidia PAH, LLC, formerly known as RareGen.

We currently generate revenue through the sale of YUTREPIA (treprostinil) inhalation powder ("YUTREPIA") and pursuant to a promotion agreement with Sandoz Inc. ("Sandoz"), dated as of August 1, 2018, as amended (the "Promotion Agreement"), under which we share profit derived from the sale of Sandoz's generic treprostinil injection ("Treprostinil Injection") in the United States.

We employ a targeted commercial field force calling on healthcare providers involved in the treatment of PAH and PH-ILD in the United States, as well as key stakeholders involved in the distribution and reimbursement of medicines to treat these patients.

YUTREPIA is an inhaled dry powder formulation of treprostinil designed with our proprietary PRINT technology, a particle engineering platform that enables precise production of uniform drug particles, to improve the therapeutic profile of treprostinil by enhancing deep lung delivery while using a convenient, low effort dry-powder inhaler ("DPI") and by achieving higher dose levels than the labeled doses of other marketed inhaled treprostinil therapies. YUTREPIA was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") in May 2025 for the treatment of both PAH and PH-ILD, and began commercialization in June 2025.

Treprostinil Injection is a fully-substitutable generic treprostinil for parenteral administration in the United States. We have the exclusive rights to conduct commercial activities for Treprostinil Injection and work jointly with Sandoz on commercial strategy for the product. Sandoz retains all other rights in and to Treprostinil Injection and holds the Abbreviated New Drug Application ("ANDA") for Treprostinil Injection.

We also conduct research, development and manufacturing of novel products by applying our subject matter expertise in respiratory and vascular diseases. For example, we are currently developing L606, an investigational, liposomal formulation of treprostinil, which we licensed from Pharmosa Biopharm Inc. ("Pharmosa"), that is administered twice-daily with a short-duration next-generation nebulizer. L606 is currently being evaluated in an open-label study in the United States for treatment of PAH and PH-ILD, and we have initiated a worldwide, placebo-controlled pivotal study for the treatment of PH-ILD. We are also planning to conduct clinical studies to evaluate YUTREPIA for the treatment of pulmonary hypertension associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease ("PH-COPD"), idiopathic pulmonary
fibrosis ("IPF"), progressive pulmonary fibrosis ("PPF") and Raynaud's phenomenon associated with systemic sclerosis ("SSc-RP").

Pulmonary hypertension ("PH") is divided into five groups based on the criteria of the World Health Organization ("WHO") as defined at the 8th World Symposium on Pulmonary Hypertension. WHO Group 1 is comprised of individuals with PAH. WHO Group 3 includes patients with pulmonary hypertension caused by hypoxia and/or lung diseases, mostly interstitial lung disease ("ILD"), chronic obstructive pulmonary disease ("COPD") and sleep-disordered breathing. Our current products initially seek to address unmet needs in PAH and PH-ILD.

PAH is a rare, chronic, progressive disease caused by hardening and narrowing of the pulmonary arteries that can lead to right heart failure and eventually death, with an estimated diagnosed, treated prevalence in the United States of approximately 45,000 patients.

PH-ILD is the second most prevalent form of Group 3 PH (precapillary PH due to lung disease). ILD is a diverse collection of more than 150 different pulmonary diseases, including IPF, chronic hypersensitivity pneumonitis, connective tissue disease related ILD, and sarcoidosis among others. We currently estimate diagnosed and undiagnosed prevalence of PH-ILD in the United States to be approximately 60,000. The prevalence of PH in many of the underlying ILD diseases is not yet known due to factors including underdiagnosis and lack of approved treatments until 2021.

There is currently no cure for PAH or PH-ILD, so the goals of existing treatments are to alleviate symptoms, maintain or improve functional class, delay disease progression and improve quality of life. The FDA has approved several classes of drugs to treat PAH over the last 25 years, including drugs acting through the prostacyclin pathway, the nitric oxide pathway, the endothelin pathway, and the inhibition of activin signaling. There are currently only three FDA-approved treatments for PH-ILD, all of which are inhaled forms of treprostinil, a prostacyclin analog. Without a curative treatment, we expect continued development of new mechanisms of action that may be used in combination with approved treatments.

Drugs targeting the prostacyclin pathway are central to PAH and PH-ILD therapy. Prostacyclin analogs, like treprostinil, have been developed for continuous infusion, inhalation and oral administration. The maximal efficacy benefit of any one drug in the prostacyclin pathway is partially limited by its specific safety profile and the burden of administration. Increased drug exposure of prostacyclin analogs like treprostinil, if tolerated by the patient, has demonstrated increased clinical benefit, making it the only titratable mechanism of action to treat these diseases.

Delivering prostacyclin analogs by inhalation has been effective and causes fewer systemic side effects than parenteral and oral formulations. Inhalation helps supplement the endogenous production of prostacyclin where it is normally synthesized, near the targeted pulmonary arteries. As a result, inhaled prostacyclin analogs help avoid side effects related to off-target tissues and take advantage of binding key prostacyclin receptors that are preferentially expressed in the lung. The only inhaled prostacyclin analogs approved by the FDA are nebulized Ventavis® (iloprost), nebulized Tyvaso® (treprostinil), Tyvaso DPI® (treprostinil), which is United Therapeutics' dry powder inhaled formulation, and YUTREPIA, which is our dry powder inhaled formulation. Observations from a large retrospective study of Tyvaso supported the finding that higher doses of inhaled treprostinil correlated to better clinical outcomes including delayed transition to more invasive administration, persistence on therapy, and improved three-year survival. With regard to PH-ILD, there is growing medical preference for inhaled therapies to avoid ventilation-perfusion mismatch resulting from systemic delivery of prostacyclins. In March 2021, the FDA approved Tyvaso as the first treatment for PH-ILD. Tyvaso DPI and YUTREPIA were subsequently approved as treatment options upon their approval by the FDA in May 2022 and May 2025, respectively.

Systemic delivery of prostacyclin has proven effective but challenging, especially in those patients who have progressed to more severe forms of PAH. Parenteral delivery of prostacyclin analogs by continuous infusion via intravenous or subcutaneous administration, like Remodulin® (treprostinil) and epoprostenol, are considered the most effective treatment for PAH; however, the burden of external pumps and side-effect profiles have limited their use to severely ill patients. Regardless, physicians have come to rely on these pump-delivered products to stabilize rapidly declining patients to slow disease progression and to ensure the mechanism of action is fully maximized.

headings: Risks Related to our Financial Position and Need for Additional Capital
We have a history of losses and our ability to sustain profitability in the future remains uncertain.
Our management has broad discretion in using our available capital and may not use it effectively.

We depend on skilled labor, and our business and prospects may be adversely affected if we lose the services of our skilled personnel, including those in senior management, or are unable to attract new skilled personnel.
Our ability to use our net operating loss carry forwards and research and development tax credits may be limited.
Changes to existing tax laws, or challenges to our tax positions could adversely affect our business and financial condition.

We are a biopharmaceutical company with only one approved product that was only recently approved by the FDA, which may make it difficult for you to evaluate our business, financial condition and prospects.
Medical devices, which we do not control, are necessary for the administration of YUTREPIA, L606 and Treprostinil Injection.
We maintain our cash at financial institutions, often in balances that exceed federally insured limits.
Risks Related to the Commercialization of our Products, Product Candidates and Generic Treprostinil Injection

● Endothelin receptor antagonists to treat PAH, such as bosentan and macitentan, both marketed by Actelion, and ambrisentan, marketed by Gilead. Generic versions of bosentan and ambrisentan are currently available.
● PDE-5 inhibitors to treat PAH, such as tadalafil, marketed by United Therapeutics, and sildenafil, marketed by Pfizer Inc. Generic versions of both tadalafil and sildenafil are currently available.
● sGC stimulators, such as oral riociguat marketed by Bayer for PAH, and inhaled mosliciguat, an sGC activator, being developed by Pulmovant for PH-ILD.
● Activin signaling inhibitor to treat PAH, such as sotatercept marketed by Merck & Co.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks described below, as well as the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our financial statements and the related notes thereto, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," and the information contained under the heading "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" before deciding

whether to invest in our common stock. The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations and growth prospects. In such an event, the market price of our common stock could decline and you may lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial also may impair our business operations. We may update these risk factors in our periodic and other filings with the SEC.
The following is a summary of the principal risk factors described in this section:

● We are primarily dependent on the success of YUTREPIA, for which we recently received FDA approval for the treatment of PAH and PH-ILD, and L606, and these products and product candidates may fail to receive or to maintain final marketing approval (in a timely manner or at all) for some or all of the indications for which we have received or are seeking approval or may not be commercialized successfully.

● United Therapeutics has initiated multiple lawsuits against us in which it has claimed that YUTREPIA is infringing its patents and two separate lawsuits against us that we and a former United Therapeutics employee, who later joined us as an employee, conspired to misappropriate certain trade secrets of United Therapeutics and engaged in unfair or deceptive trade practices and that United Therapeutics is entitled to an ownership interest in a portion of our intellectual property. In several of these proceedings, United Therapeutics is seeking injunctive relief that would require YUTREPIA to be withdrawn from the market. These lawsuits, and other lawsuits that United Therapeutics may file in the future, may result in our company being unable to maintain FDA approval for YUTREPIA in PAH and/or PH-ILD or require us to stop selling YUTREPIA for one or both such indications, result in substantial damage claims against us if we are found to infringe any patents or to have misappropriated trade secrets, or result in United Therapeutics owning an interest in a portion of our intellectual property.
● We may be unable to manufacture sufficient quantities of our products to meet future commercial demand.

paragraphs: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with our financial statements and related notes appearing in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion and other parts of this Annual Report on Form 10-K contain forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties, such as statements of our plans, objectives, expectations and intentions. As a result of many factors, including those factors set forth in the "Risk Factors" section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, our actual results could differ materially from the results described in, or implied by, the forward-looking statements contained in the following discussion and analysis.

In this Item 7, we discuss the results of operations for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 and comparisons of the year ended December 31, 2025 to the year ended December 31, 2024. Discussion and analysis of our 2024 fiscal year specifically, as well as the year-over-year comparison of our 2024 financial performance to 2023, are located in Part II, Item 7 - Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on March 18, 2025 (which have been revised in Exhibit 99.1 to our Current Report on Form 8-K filed on May 8, 2025).

The following Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations is intended to provide information necessary to understand our audited consolidated financial statements for the two-year period ended December 31, 2025 and highlight certain other information which, in the opinion of management, will enhance a reader's understanding of our financial condition, changes in financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows. In particular, the discussion is intended to provide an analysis of significant trends and material changes in our financial position and the operating results of our business during the year ended December 31, 2025, as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. This discussion should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements for the two-year period ended the year ended December 31, 2025 and related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Since inception, we have incurred significant operating losses. Our net loss was $68.9 million, $128.3 million, and $78.5 million for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $626.3 million. We expect to incur significant expenses for the foreseeable future as we continue commercialization of YUTREPIA and advance our product candidates through clinical trials, seek regulatory approval of such product candidates and pursue commercialization of any such approved product candidates. These efforts require significant amounts of capital, adequate personnel and infrastructure, and extensive compliance-reporting capabilities. It is uncertain whether we will be able to generate sustained revenue from YUTREPIA sales and, even if our development efforts are successful with other product candidates, whether and when, if ever, we will realize sustained revenue from sales of such additional product candidates. Additionally, our HCR Agreement contains fixed quarterly payments and minimum cash covenants that require us to maintain cash and cash equivalents in an amount at least equal to $15.0 million for the remainder of the payment term, which based on amounts funded as of December 31, 2025, is expected to conclude in 2033.

Our future funding requirements will be heavily determined by whether we are able to successfully maintain FDA approval for and commercialize YUTREPIA and the resources needed to support further development of our products and product candidates. Based on current operating plans and excluding any additional external financing, we will have sufficient cash and cash equivalents to fund operating expenses and capital requirements and meet our minimum cash covenants beyond one year from the issuance of these consolidated financial statements. We have based this estimate on assumptions that may prove to be wrong, and we could be limited in our ability to continue to commercialize YUTREPIA and/or we could utilize our available capital resources sooner than we currently expect, which would have a material impact on our operations.

We began generating revenue from the sales of YUTREPIA in June 2025, following the FDA approval on May 23, 2025, for the treatment of PAH and PH-ILD. Revenues from product sales are recognized net of variable consideration due to rebates, chargebacks, trade discounts and allowances, sales returns, and other incentives. Provisions for estimated reductions to revenue are provided for in the same period the related sales are recorded and are based on contractual terms, actual utilization data, forecasted payor mix, total prescriptions and industry data. We expect product sales to increase if we are able to maintain FDA approval for YUTREPIA and gain market share.

paragraphs: 本公司為一間以科學與同理心為驅動的生物製藥公司，致力於革新治療具有挑戰性的呼吸道與血管疾病患者的照護，例如肺動脈髒壓（"PAH"）及與間質性肺病相關的肺動脈髒壓（"PH-ILD"）。本公司透過我們全資擁有之營運子公司 Liquidia Technologies, Inc. 及 Liquidia PAH, LLC（原名為 RareGen）進行營運。

本公司目前透過銷售 YUTREPIA（treprostinil 吸入粉末）（"YUTREPIA"）以及根據與 Sandoz Inc.（"Sandoz"）於 2018 年 8 月 1 日簽訂之促銷協議（"Promotion Agreement"），經修正後，透過該協議，本公司與 Sandoz 共享美國銷售 Sandoz 之 generic treprostinil 注射液（"Treprostinil Injection"）所產生之利潤。
本公司聘請專注於美國治療 PAH 及 PH-ILD 之醫療保健提供者，以及參與這些患者治療藥物分銷與給付之關鍵利益相關者之商業推廣團隊。

YUTREPIA 為一種吸入式乾粉配方之 treprostinil，採用本公司專利之 PRINT 技術，為一顆粒工程平台，可精確生產均勻藥物顆粒，以改善 treprostinil 之治療特性，透過方便、低耗力之乾粉吸入器（"DPI"）提升深層肺部給藥，並達到高於其他市售吸入式 treprostinil 療法標籤劑量之劑量水平。YUTREPIA 於 2025 年 5 月獲美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）核准，用於治療 PAH 及 PH-ILD，並於 2025 年 6 月開始商業化。

Treprostinil Injection 是一種完全可替代的泛用型 Treprostinil，用於美國的靜脈給藥。本公司擁有 Treprostinil Injection 的獨家商業活動權，並與 Sandoz 合作制定該產品的商業策略。Sandoz 保留 Treprostinil Injection 其他所有權利，並持有 Treprostinil Injection 的簡化新藥申請 ("ANDA")。

本公司亦透過運用在呼吸道及血管疾病領域的專業知識，進行新產品的研究、開發與製造。例如，本公司目前正在開發 L606，這是一種正在研發中的脂質體型 Treprostinil，已自 Pharmosa Biopharm Inc. ("Pharmosa") 取得授權，此藥物每日兩次給藥，使用短效新一代霧化器。L606 目前正在美國進行開放標籤研究，用於治療肺動脈髒脈症候羣 (PAH) 和肺動脈髒脈症候羣伴隨間質性肺病 (PH-ILD)，且本公司已啟動一項全球性、安慰劑對照的關鍵性研究，用於治療 PH-ILD。本公司亦計畫進行臨牀研究，評估 YUTREPIA 用於治療與慢性阻塞性肺病 ("PH-COPD")、特發性肺纖維化 ("IPF")、進行性肺纖維化 ("PPF") 以及與系統性硬化症相關的雷諾氏現象 ("SSc-RP") 有關的肺動脈髒脈症候羣。

肺動脈髒脈症候羣 ("PH") 根據世界衛生組織 ("WHO") 在第八屆肺動脈髒脈症候羣國際研討會所定義的標準，分為五類。WHO 第一類為患有肺動脈髒脈症候羣 (PAH) 的個體。WHO 第三類包括因低氧血癥和/或肺部疾病所引起的肺動脈髒脈症候羣患者，主要是間質性肺病 ("ILD")、慢性阻塞性肺病 ("COPD") 和睡眠呼吸障礙。本公司目前的產品最初旨在解決 PAH 和 PH-ILD 的未滿足需求。

肺動脈髒脈症候羣 ("PH") 根據世界衛生組織 ("WHO") 在第八屆肺動脈髒脈症候羣國際研討會所定義的標準，分為五類。WHO 第一類為患有肺動脈髒脈症候羣 (PAH) 的個體。WHO 第三類包括因低氧血癥和/或肺部疾病所引起的肺動脈髒脈症候羣患者，主要是間質性肺病 ("ILD")、慢性阻塞性肺病 ("COPD") 和睡眠呼吸障礙。本公司目前的產品最初旨在解決 PAH 和 PH-ILD 的未滿足需求。
PAH 是一種罕見、慢性、進行性疾病，由肺動脈硬化與狹窄引起，可能導致右心衰竭，最終致命，美國診斷並接受治療的患者數量估計約為 45,000 人。
PH-ILD 是第三類 PH（肺動脈前微血管阻塞型 PH）中第二常見的類型。ILD 是一種包含超過 150 種不同肺部疾病的廣泛集合，包括 IPF、慢性過敏性肺炎、結締組織疾病相關 ILD，以及結核病等。我們目前估計美國診斷與未診斷的 PH-ILD 患者數量約為 60,000 人。許多基礎 ILD 疾病的 PH 普遍性尚不清楚，這是因為包括診斷不足與直到 2021 年纔出現核准治療等因素。

目前尚無 PAH 或 PH-ILD 的根治方法，因此現有治療目標為緩解症狀、維持或改善功能等級、延緩疾病進展並提升生活品質。美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）已核准多種藥物類別用於治療 PAH，包括透過血栓素類別途徑、一氧化氮途徑、內皮素途徑，以及抑制活化素訊號傳導的藥物。目前僅有三種 FDA 核准的 PH-ILD 治療方式，皆為吸入型的 treprostinil，一種血栓素類別模擬物。在缺乏根治性治療的情況下，我們預期會持續開發新的作用機制，可能與核准的治療方式結合使用。
針對血栓素類別途徑的藥物是 PAH 和 PH-ILD 治療的核心。血栓素類別模擬物，如 treprostinil，已開發出連續輸注、吸入及口服給藥方式。任何一種血栓素類別途徑藥物的最大療效好處，部分受限於其特定的安全性特徵與給藥負擔。若患者能耐受，增加血栓素類別模擬物如 treprostinil 的藥物暴露量，已顯示出增加臨牀好處，使其成為治療這些疾病的唯一可調節的作用機制。

透過吸入方式給予血栓素類別模擬物已被證明有效，並引起較少的全身性副作用，與靜脈注射及口服製劑相比。吸入方式有助於補充血栓素類別在正常合成位置附近的肺動脈的內源性產生。因此，吸入型血栓素類別模擬物可避免與非目標組織相關的副作用，並能利用在肺部優先表達的血栓素類別受體。美國食品藥物管理局核准的唯一吸入型血栓素類別模擬物為霧化 Ventavis®（iloprost）、霧化 Tyvaso®（treprostinil）、Tyvaso DPI®（treprostinil），這是 United Therapeutics 的乾粉吸入製劑，以及 YUTREPIA，這是我們的乾粉吸入製劑。來自 Tyvaso 大規模回溯研究的觀察結果支持了更高劑量的吸入型 treprostinil 與更好的臨牀結果相關，包括延遲轉換至更侵入性給藥、持續使用治療，以及改善三年存活率。針對 PH-ILD，醫療界正逐漸偏好吸入治療，以避免因全身性給予血栓素類別而導致的通氣-灌流不匹配。2021 年 3 月，美國食品藥物管理局核准 Tyvaso 為首個 PH-ILD 治療方式。Tyvaso DPI 與 YUTREPIA 隨後在 2022 年 5 月與 2025 年 5 月分別經 FDA 核准後，成為治療選項。

全身性給予血栓素類別已被證明有效但具有挑戰性，特別是在那些已進展至 PAH 更嚴重形式的患者。透過連續輸注方式經靜脈注射或皮下注射給予血栓素類別模擬物，如 Remodulin®（treprostinil）與 epoprostenol，被認為是 PAH 最有效的治療方式；然而，外部泵的負擔與副作用特徵已限制其使用於嚴重病患。不管如何，醫生已逐漸依賴這些泵給藥產品，以穩定快速惡化的患者，減緩疾病進展，並確保作用機制完全發揮最大效益。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析，並與本年度10-K申報表中所附之財務報表及其相關附註一併參考。本討論與分析及其他部分之內容包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性，例如我們之計畫、目標、預期與意圖之陳述。由於許多因素，包括本年度10-K申報表中「風險因素」部分所列之因素，我們之實際結果可能與下列討論與分析中所描述或暗示之前瞻性陳述結果有重大差異。

在本項目7中，我們討論了截至2025年12月31日止之年度營運成果，以及2025年12月31日止年度與2024年12月31日止年度之比較。有關2024會計年度之討論與分析，以及2024年度財務表現與2023年度之年對年比較，請參閱我們2024會計年度10-K申報表中項目7 - 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析，該申報表於2025年3月18日提交至SEC（美國證券交易委員會）（已於2025年5月8日提交之8-K現況報告附錄99.1中修正）。

以下之管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析，旨在提供理解我們截至2025年12月31日止兩年期合併財務報表所需之資訊，並強調某些其他資訊，管理層認為這些資訊有助於讀者瞭解我們之財務狀況、財務狀況之變動、營運成果與現金流。特別是，本討論旨在分析截至2025年12月31日止年度之財務狀況與營運成果之重大趨勢與重大變動，與截至2024年12月31日止年度之比較。本討論應與我們截至2025年12月31日止兩年期之合併財務報表及其相關附註一併閱讀，這些財務報表與附註已包含於本年度10-K申報表中。
我們是一家以科學與同理心為驅動的生物製藥公司，致力於革新治療具有挑戰性之呼吸道與血管疾病患者的照護，例如肺動脈髒壓（"PAH"）與與間質性肺病相關之肺動脈髒壓（"PH-ILD"）。我們透過我們完全擁有之營運子公司Liquidia Technologies, Inc.與Liquidia PAH, LLC（原為RareGen）進行營運。
我們目前透過銷售YUTREPIA（treprostinil吸入粉末）（"YUTREPIA"）以及根據與Sandoz Inc.（"Sandoz"）於2018年8月1日簽訂之促銷協議（"促銷協議"）（已修正）來產生收入，根據該協議，我們與Sandoz共同分享美國銷售Sandoz之通用treprostinil注射液（"Treprostinil注射液"）所產生之利潤。
我們聘請了一支針對性的商業銷售團隊，專門拜訪美國參與治療PAH與PH-ILD之醫療專業人員，以及參與這些患者藥物分銷與給付之關鍵利益相關者。

YUTREPIA是一種吸入式乾粉配方的treprostinil，採用我們專利的PRINT技術，一種粒子工程平台，可精確生產均勻的藥物粒子，以改善treprostinil之治療特性，透過提高深層肺部給藥，同時使用方便、低費力的乾粉吸入器（"DPI"），並達到其他市售吸入式treprostinil治療之標籤劑量以上之劑量水平。YUTREPIA於2025年5月獲美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）核准，用於治療PAH與PH-ILD，並於2025年6月開始商業化。
Treprostinil注射液是美國用於靜脈注射之完全可替代之通用treprostinil。我們擁有Treprostinil注射液之獨家商業活動權，並與Sandoz合作進行
產品的商業策略。Sandoz 保留 Treprostinil Injection 的所有權利，並持有 Treprostinil Injection 的簡化新藥申請（"ANDA"）。

我們也透過應用在呼吸道及血管疾病方面的專業知識，進行新產品的研究、開發與製造。例如，我們目前正在開發 L606，這是一款 investigational 的脂質體形式 Treprostinil，我們已從 Pharmosa Biopharm Inc.（"Pharmosa"）取得授權，此藥物為每日兩次給藥，使用短效新一代霧化器給藥。L606 目前正在美國進行開放標籤研究，用於治療肺動脈髒脈症候羣（PAH）及肺動脈髒脈症候羣-間質性肺病（PH-ILD），我們也已啟動一項全球性、安慰劑對照的關鍵性研究，用於治療 PH-ILD。我們也計畫進行臨牀研究，評估 YUTREPIA 用於治療慢性阻塞性肺病（"PH-COPD"）相關的肺動脈髒脈症候羣、特發性肺纖維化（"IPF"）、進行性肺纖維化（"PPF"）及系統性硬化症相關的雷諾氏症候羣（"SSc-RP"）。

自成立以來，我們已產生顯著的營運虧損。我們的淨虧損為 68.9 百萬美元、128.3 百萬美元及 78.5 百萬美元，分別為 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日的年度虧損。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們累計虧損為 626.3 百萬美元。我們預期在可預見的未來會產生顯著的費用，因我們持續商業化 YUTREPIA 並推進產品候選品的臨牀試驗，尋求這些產品候選品的監管批准，並追求這些批准產品的商業化。這些努力需要大量資金、足夠的人員與基礎設施，以及廣泛的合規與報告能力。我們無法確定是否能從 YUTREPIA 的銷售中產生持續收入，即使我們的開發工作在其他產品候選品上成功，也無法確定是否以及何時，如果有的話，我們能從這些額外產品候選品的銷售中產生持續收入。此外，我們的 HCR 合約包含固定季度付款及最低現金擔保，要求我們維持現金及現金等價物至少為 15.0 百萬美元，直到付款期限結束，根據截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的資金投入，預期該期限將於 2033 年結束。

我們未來的資金需求將嚴重取決於我們是否能成功維持美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）對 YUTREPIA 的批准並進行商業化，以及支持我們產品及產品候選品進一步開發所需的資源。根據目前的營運計畫，且不計任何額外外部融資，我們預期現金及現金等價物足以支應營運費用及資本需求，並符合我們的最低現金擔保，超過這些合併財務報表發佈後一年的時間。我們的估計基於可能錯誤的假設，我們可能受限於持續商業化 YUTREPIA 的能力，或可能比預期更早耗盡可用資金，這將對我們的營運產生重大影響。

我們在 2025 年 6 月開始從 YUTREPIA 的銷售中產生收入，這是在 2025 年 5 月 23 日取得美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准，用於治療肺動脈髒脈症候羣（PAH）及肺動脈髒脈症候羣-間質性肺病（PH-ILD）之後。產品銷售收入會扣除變動考慮因素，包括回扣、退貨、販售折扣與允許、銷售退回及其他激勵措施。預計收入減少的準備金會在相關銷售記帳的同一期間內提供，並根據契約條款、實際使用數據、預測付款人結構、總處方數及產業數據進行計算。我們預期產品銷售會增加，如果我們能維持 YUTREPIA 的 FDA 批准並獲得市場份額。

我們主要透過 Promotion Agreement 產生服務收入，根據此協議，我們會獲得美國 Treprostinil Injection 売出利潤的 50%。Liquidia PAH 有獨家權進行商業活動，以促進 Treprostinil Injection 的適當使用。目前，患者必須使用 ICU Medical 所製造的 CADD-MS 3 靜脈注射泵來進行 Treprostinil Injection 的皮下注射。ICU Medical 已不再製造或支援 CADD-MS 3 靜脈注射泵。儘管我們認為 CADD-MS 3 靜脈注射泵的數量將足以服務患者至至少 2025 年 12 月 31 日

headings: 與我們財務狀況相關的風險及對額外資金的需求
我們有持續虧損的歷史，且我們未來維持獲利能力的狀況仍屬不確定。
我們的管理階層對使用現有資金有廣泛的裁量權，且可能無法有效運用。
我們依賴具專業技能的勞工，若我們失去具專業技能人員的服務，包括高階管理人員，或無法吸引新的具專業技能人員，將可能對我們的業務與前景產生不利影響。
我們使用淨營業虧損結轉及研究發展稅額抵減的能力可能受到限制。
現行稅法的變更，或對我們稅務立場的挑戰，可能對我們的業務與財務狀況產生不利影響。
我們是一家生技藥品公司，目前僅有單一已核准產品，且該產品僅於近期獲美國食品藥物管理局核准，這可能使您難以評估我們的業務、財務狀況與前景。
我們不控制的醫療器材是YUTREPIA、L606及Treprostinil Injection給藥所必需的。
我們將現金存放於金融機構，經常會有超過聯邦保險上限的存款額。
與我們產品、產品候選藥物及通用 Treprostinil 注射劑商業化相關的風險
● 用於治療肺動脈髒脈症候羣（PAH）的內皮素受體拮抗劑，例如 bosentan 和 macitentan，均由 Actelion 市場推廣，以及 ambrisentan，由 Gilead 市場推廣。目前已有 bosentan 和 ambrisentan 的通用版本。
● 用於治療肺動脈髒脈症候羣（PAH）的 PDE-5 抑制劑，例如 tadalafil，由 United Therapeutics 市場推廣，以及 sildenafil，由 Pfizer Inc. 市場推廣。目前已有 tadalafil 和 sildenafil 的通用版本。
● sGC 激活劑，例如 Bayer 用於治療肺動脈髒脈症候羣（PAH）的口服 riociguat，以及 Pulmovant 開發用於 PH-ILD 的吸入式 mosliciguat，為 sGC 激活劑。
● 用於治療肺動脈髒脈症候羣（PAH）的 Activin 信號抑制劑，例如 Merck & Co. 市場推廣的 sotatercept
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報告表 10-K 中的其他資訊，包括財務報表及相關附註、『管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析』，以及標題為『對未來預測陳述之警示』的資訊，再決定是否投資本公司的普通股。上述任何事件或發展的發生，可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與成長前景造成損害。在這種情況下，本公司普通股的市場價格可能會下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知或本公司認為不重要，也可能影響本公司業務營運。
我們可能在定期及其他向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的文件中更新這些風險因素。
下列為本節所描述的主要風險因素之總結：
● 我們主要依賴 YUTREPIA 的成功，我們最近已獲得美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准用於治療肺動脈髒脈症候羣（PAH）及肺動脈髒脈症候羣-間質性肺病（PH-ILD），以及 L606，這些產品及產品候選藥物可能無法取得或維持最終的市場批准（在及時或完全的程度上），或無法成功商業化。

● 美國治療公司（United Therapeutics）已對我們提起多起訴訟，聲稱 YUTREPIA 侵權其專利，並提起兩起分離的訴訟，聲稱我們與一名前美國治療公司員工（該員工後加入我們成為員工）共謀竊取美國治療公司的商業機密，並進行不當或欺詐性商業行為，且美國治療公司有權取得本公司智慧財產權的一部分所有權。在這些訴訟中，美國治療公司聲請法院發出禁制令，要求將 YUTREPIA 從市場撤出。這些訴訟，以及美國治療公司未來可能提出的其他訴訟，可能會導致本公司無法維持 YUTREPIA 在 PAH 和/或 PH-ILD 的 FDA 批准，或要求我們停止銷售 YUTREPIA 用於一個或兩個這樣的適應症，或導致我們被裁定侵權任何專利或竊取商業機密而產生重大賠償請求，或導致美國治療公司取得本公司智慧財產權的一部分所有權。
● 我們可能無法製造足夠數量的產品以滿足未來的商業需求。
